## ✨ Highlights

Fresh kernels and dependencies.

- 🔒 **Linux 6.18.65 for nodes on the longterm kernel**: it fixes a
  use-after-free rated high in KSM, which Janus's kernel doesn't build,
  and 11 other memory-management fixes not rated yet.
- 📦 **Linux 7.3.6** (the default kernel track), Go's `x/net` 0.63.0,
  the Controller built on a refreshed Go image.

Everything else is as in v2026.11.20.

## 🔒 Security

- **Linux kernel (longterm) 6.18.64 → 6.18.65** (nodes pinned to the longterm kernel track - `"kernel": "longterm"` in their schematic):
  - 🟠 high [CVE-2026-99650](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99650) - mm/ksm: fix use of a freed anon_vma at swap-in;
  - ⚫ unknown [CVE-2026-99595](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99595) - sched/fair: Clear throttle state when leaving the fair class;
  - ⚫ unknown [CVE-2026-99637](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99637) - ovl: inherit FMODE_NONOTIFY when opening directory realfiles;
  - ⚫ unknown [CVE-2026-99646](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99646) - mm/vma: don't leak the charge for stack growth;
  - ⚫ unknown [CVE-2026-99652](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99652) - mm: fix deadlock of mremap() against UFFDIO_MOVE;
  - ⚫ unknown [CVE-2026-99706](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99706) - mm: fix address wraparound when scanning large folio PTEs;
  - ⚫ unknown [CVE-2026-99727](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99727) - mm/huge_memory: properly handle refcounted PUD mappings on fork;
  - ⚫ unknown [CVE-2026-99729](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99729) - mm/rmap: handle device-exclusive entries in folio_referenced_one();
  - ⚫ unknown [CVE-2026-99732](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99732) - mm/filemap: read mapping->a_ops->free_folio under i_lock;
  - ⚫ unknown [CVE-2026-99734](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99734) - mm/shmem: make shmem_file() check the file's inode;
  - ⚫ unknown [CVE-2026-99736](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99736) - mm/shmem: fix accounting of swapin-error markers;
  - ⚫ unknown [CVE-2026-99738](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99738) - mm/shmem: preserve allocation errors when swapping in large entries;
  - 11 more don't apply to Janus's build.

What it means for a node:

- **CVE-2026-99650** is in KSM (kernel samepage merging): a page shared
  by KSM and read back from swap could be compared against a freed
  structure. Janus's kernel is built **without KSM and without swap**.
  The fix also moves a helper into `mm/util.c`, which is built, and
  that is why it's counted for Janus. We know of no way to reach the bug
  on a node.
- The other fixes are in memory management and the scheduler, in code
  the longterm kernel builds. None is rated yet.
- **Nodes on the default kernel track (7.3) aren't concerned**: 7.3.6
  fixes no known vulnerability. The Controller's update badge (🔒) shows
  only on nodes whose image pins the longterm kernel.

## 📦 Components

- **Linux 7.3.6** (default track, was 7.3.5) and **6.18.65** (longterm,
  was 6.18.64). kbuild resolves their configurations the same way
  ([#713](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/713)).
- **`golang.org/x/net` 0.63.0** (was 0.62.0) in janusd, janusctl, the
  Controller and the Terraform provider. No security fix
  ([#713](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/713)).
- **The Controller's image and the `prometheus-node-exporter`
  extension** are built on a refreshed `golang:1.27.4` image (a new
  Debian base under the same Go)
  ([#713](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/713)).
- **Controller and site pages**: lucide-react 1.77.0 (the clock icons
  are redrawn) and oxlint 1.94.0. **Docs site**: Astro,
  starlight-image-zoom and markdownlint-cli2 updated
  ([#713](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/713)).
